flags.description: Rainforest Action Network documented illegal palm oil plantations inside the protected Leuser Ecosystem in Sumatra linked to P&G's supply chain, and reports P&G has repeatedly failed to fulfill its public commitments to restore the destroyed rainforest.
Rainforest Action Network reports P&G has knowingly sourced palm oil tied to forced-labor practices for brands including Head & Shoulders, Pantene, and Gillette.
